messages:
sam: quick sync 1 — need an authoritive SI co-sell rule for deals that include marketplace SKUs + hardware partners. had two ops where ownership was unclear.

maya: agree. my quick take: certified HW bundle -> SI owns. marketplace SKUs default to AE unless Partnerships explicitly opt-in. ARR override if >= 250k.

oliver: add 48h handoff SLA after stage flips. AE must attach: deal brief, commerce sku export, customer contact. missing pieces auto-escalate to #partners-ops.

kelly: on rebates: intake should include rebate_owner enum (Partner / Redwood / Shared). Finance will populate final in contract. also record 'rebate_contact'.

finance-bot: Note: finance prefers rebate_owner to be set before legal kick-off for accurate MRR modeling.

maya: edge case: referral-only deals (no HW). default owner AE unless ARR >= 200k or partner requests co-sell opt-in. add referral_credit numeric field.

oliver: multi-SI conflict rule: earliest partner registration timestamp wins; partner must confirm within 24h or fallback to AE. store registration_ts in intake.

sam: co-announcement cadence: standard 10 business days prep for co-branded assets. intake should include announce_request boolean + announce_timing_days default 10. legal + marketing signoff required.

kelly: i'll export SKU whitelist and add a 'certified_hw' boolean mapping for bundles. also will add a 'private_deploy' flag that triggers Enterprise ops and legal.

maya: action items: 1) Maya: add decision table + intake PR with YAML mapping. 2) Oliver: workflow for 48h SLA auto-escalation and multi-SI tie-break. 3) Kelly: SKU whitelist + rebate_owner fields. 4) Sam: calendar for 10bd announce cadence and checklist.

partners-bot: Task PART-4832 created: "SI co-sell intake + gate table" assigned to maya, oliver, kelly, due in 5 days. https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PART-4832

sam: sounds good. start conservative (manual opt-in for marketplace SKUs) and we'll iterate with telemetry.

maya: will open PR by EOD and tag the group here.

kelly: noted. thanks.
